rows.en: Variable fighters, developed using the OverTechnology of the Macross.\nTo learn how they evolved, battle the variable fighters of every generation.
rows.notes: Kahen kitai (variable machines) rendered as 'variable fighters'. | review: refit: pronoun for repeated 'variable fighters'

rows.en: Annihilate the Zentradi forces.
A massive Zentradi horde has appeared and is about to invade Earth once again.\nProtect Earth from this crisis: annihilate the Zentradi forces at all costs.
To be accepted as a security guard,\nfight a mock battle with Basara's band.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'hold ... with Basara and the band' -> 'fight ... with Basara's band'

rows.en: Venue security test for Fire Bomber's special live: can you stay cool through\nBasara and the band's red-hot songs? Win the mock battle vs. Fire Bomber.
rows.notes: Source spells the band in full-width capitals; glossary spelling 'Fire Bomber' used. 'Basara-tachi' = Basara and his bandmates. | review: refit: restructured as a test question

rows.en: Fight wild with a burning heart!
Basara: "Now it's red-hot live time! We'll slam our hearts right into you!\n         So let's go big and flashy! Get wild and FIRE!"
rows.notes: Speaker-prefix format kept; continuation indented with spaces to align under the opening quote, as the source does with full-width spaces. | review: 'Go out with a bang' means to finish spectacularly; the source line opens the show (let's go flashy), it does not end anything. | review: refit: tightened line 1

rows.en: Make it out of Macross Heaven alive.
The Macross that ended the interstellar war passed its name on to colony ships.\nMake it out alive from Macross Heaven, packed with ships bearing that name.
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured; dropped 'that travel the galaxy'

rows.en: Wipe out the swarming hordes of small fry.
The enemy is throwing sheer numbers at us. Teach them that "quality" beats\n"quantity" in battle: sweep away the small-fry horde in the wasteland at once.
rows.notes: review: Source describes a brute-numbers strategy; 'war of attrition' (a long wearing-down fight) is added meaning not in the source. | review: refit: restructured

rows.en: Wipe out the swarming hordes of small fry.
The enemy is throwing sheer numbers at us. Teach them that "quality" beats\n"quantity" in battle: sweep away the small-fry horde in the wasteland at once.
rows.notes: review: Source describes a brute-numbers strategy; 'war of attrition' (a long wearing-down fight) is added meaning not in the source. | review: refit: restructured

rows.en: Set your ecstasy ablaze\nin a one-of-a-kind fight!
Sheryl: "From here on, it's special live time. Are you ready, Ranka-chan?"\nRanka: "Yes! So... everyone, hold me tight! To the ends of the galaxy!! Kira☆"
rows.notes: Sheryl's honorific '-chan' for Ranka kept. | review: refit: 'All the way to the ends of the galaxyyy' -> 'To the ends of the galaxy'

rows.en: This is the day we take down\nEditorial Sentai Dengeki V, no matter what!
rows.notes: Villain-side objective; 'we' chosen for the player's side.

rows.en: Dr. Editor-in-Chief Nishioka formed Editorial Sentai Dengeki V for world peace!\nWhen these Dengeki editors' hearts unite, their giant robot smashes evil!!
rows.notes: Glossary alias 'Dr. Editor-in-Chief Nishioka' used. | review: refit: restructured; dropped quotes around team name

rows.en: Defeat the Famitsu editors blocking your\nprobe and uncover the collection's secret.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'obstructing your investigation' -> 'blocking your probe'; 'secret of the collection' -> 'collection's secret'

rows.en: To guard a prized collection, Hamamura Tsushin made the Weekly Famitsu office\na super dimension fortress. Find out what collection is worth going that far.
rows.notes: Hamamura Tsushin gender unknown in glossary: neutral wording (no his/her). | review: refit: restructured; 'editorial office' -> 'office'; 'worth going that far to protect' -> 'worth going that far'

rows.en: Annihilate the ones rampaging in the city\nwho wield "giant" power.
Wipe out the Regults rampaging in the city now, but we sense a "giant" power\nbehind them, so never drop your guard. Annihilate those with "giant" power.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened

rows.en: Win the mock battle against the special\nforces unit Moon Island Platoon.
A mock battle now begins vs. the special forces unit codenamed "Moon Island".\nThey're all problem children, but reportedly skilled. Defeat Moon Island.
rows.notes: Codename in quotes kept as 'Moon Island' (glossary alias); unit name 'Moon Island Platoon' elsewhere. | review: refit: tightened; 'Moon Island Platoon' -> 'Moon Island' as in source

rows.en: Seize victory from Roy Focker.
Roy Focker: the U.N. ace who loves booze, women, and above all the open sky.\nDefeat Focker, whose skills have made him the very model of a pilot.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'U.N. Forces ace pilot' -> 'U.N. ace'

rows.en: Seize victory from Shin Kudo.
Shin Kudo washed up on Mayan Island and grew through the many people he met.\nDefeat Shin, the idiot who'd throw his life away for the woman he holds dear.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened

rows.en: Seize victory from the duo\nof Ivanov and Nora.
D.D. Ivanov and Nora Polyansky: the aces of the Anti-U.N. Forces.\nDefeat this dangerous couple, whose skills ran the U.N. Forces ragged.
Seize victory from the Bird Human.
Sara Nome, Guide of the Wind, charged with stopping the Bird Human's revival.\nDefeat the Bird Human, revived in spite of all her efforts.
rows.notes: Sara's title 'kaze no michibikite' rendered 'Guide of the Wind'; not in glossary. | review: term added to glossary | review: refit: tightened line 1

rows.en: Seize victory from the genius Max\nand the ace Milia.
Genius pilot Max and ace Milia, who made the first-ever interstellar marriage.\nDefeat the Jenius couple, also a bridge to peace with the Zentradi.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened line 1

rows.en: Seize victory from\nQuamzin Kravshera.
Quamzin Kravshera, boss of the Quamzin family, notorious as the Ally Killer.\nDefeat Boss Quamzin, in such a fine mood he's riding a Destroid Monster.
rows.notes: 'Mikata-goroshi' epithet rendered 'the Ally Killer'; 'ikka/oyabun' given yakuza flavour as 'family/boss'.

rows.en: Seize victory from Golg Boddole Zer.
Golg Boddole Zer: Zentradi fleet Supreme Commander over a full 5 million ships.\nDefeat the ruthless Boddole Zer, who'd readily kill his own troops to win.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened

rows.en: Seize victory from the duo\nof Isamu and Guld.
Isamu and Guld: stuck together since childhood, they fight whenever they meet.\nDefeat the Dalmatian High School duo, seemingly at odds but friends at heart.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened

rows.en: Seize victory from Captain Max.
Maximilian Jenius, space carrier Battle 7's captain and a commander of genius.\nDefeat the Battle 7, which fought its way through the fierce Protodeviln war.
rows.notes: Source has a full-width yen sign + full-width n instead of the backslash-n break (a source typo that would display literally). Written as the real backslash-n break, like every other briefing; literal break count 0 -> 1 is deliberate. | review: refit: restructured

rows.en: Seize victory from Gavil and Glavil.
Gavil, a Protodeviln with a unique sense of beauty, and Glavil, a monster-like\nProtodeviln of immense combat power. Defeat the Beauty and the Monster.
rows.notes: review: refit: moved break

rows.en: Triumph over His Excellency Gepelnitchi.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'Seize victory from' -> 'Triumph over' (title kept)

rows.en: His Excellency Gepelnitchi: Varauta supreme commander, mightiest Protodeviln.\nDefeat His Excellency Gepelnitchi, who could drain the galaxy of its Spiritia.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened

rows.en: Seize victory from Gamlin Kizaki.
Gamlin Kizaki, elite pilot of the U.N. Forces' Diamond Force.\nDefeat Gamlin, nicknamed "Martian" as a child for his wide forehead.
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured line 2

rows.en: Seize victory from the duo\nof Basara and Graham.
Graham, who hates and would kill the Galaxy Whales, and Basara, who was\nmoved to sing to them. Defeat these men burning with passion for the whales.
rows.notes: review: refit: moved break; 'Galaxy Whales' -> 'whales' on second mention

rows.en: Seize victory from Ozma Lee.
Ozma Lee: seasoned S.M.S. Skull Squadron leader, overprotective of his sister.\nDefeat Ozma, who smashed death flag after death flag throughout the story.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened line 1

rows.en: Seize victory from Jeffrey,\ncaptain of the Macross Quarter.
rows.notes: Order of the two halves swapped for English; break count unchanged.

rows.en: The Macross Quarter: ARMD-class in size, yet it bears the name Macross.\nDefeat the Macross Quarter, captained by Jeffrey Wilder.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened line 1

rows.en: Seize victory from Klan Klang.
Klan Klang, Pixie Team leader, clumsy not just in her genes but in love too.\nDefeat Klan, a maiden sunk in rage and grief after losing the one she loved.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened line 1

rows.en: Seize victory from the duo\nof Alto and Brera.
"Being linked to you made it clear. However far you go, people are alone!"\n"That's why we...!", "But!!", "It's precisely because we're alone that...",
rows.notes: Quotes from the Macross F finale; speakers are unnamed in the source and left unnamed. Row ends on a trailing comma in the source (deliberately unfinished); kept. | review: refit: tightened line 1

rows.en: Seize victory from Ranka Lee.
Manipulated by Grace, Ranka Lee guards the Vajra planet to atone for her sins.\nDefeat Ranka, who sings to protect the Vajra homeworld.
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened line 1

rows.en: Seize victory from the Vajra Queen.
Even the Protoculture feared their power, envied it, and at last deified them,\ncopying their form: the super-dimensional Vajra. Defeat Grace's Vajra Queen.
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured; 'controlled by Grace' -> 'Grace's'

rows.en: Seize victory from the enemy battleships\nnew to the fight in this game.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'joining the fight for the first time' -> 'new to the fight'

rows.en: Macross is full of giant battleships, and needless to say, so is this game.\nDefeat the giant enemy battleships making their debut in this game.
rows.notes: review: refit: restructured

rows.en: Practice piloting in Fighter mode.
Ranka: "I, Ranka Lee, am gonna explain the basic Fighter mode controls!\n        I'm nervous I won't explain it well, but I'll do my best. Kira☆"
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened line 2

rows.en: Practice piloting in Battroid mode.
Sheryl: "Oh, fine. I'll explain the basic Battroid mode controls for you.\n         Sheryl herself is explaining, so don't you dare miss a single word."
Practice piloting in GERWALK mode.
Ranka: "Okay! Next, I'll explain the basic GERWALK mode controls.\n        Listen to me and get the GERWALK mode controls down perfectly!"
rows.notes: review: refit: 'my explanation' -> 'me'

rows.en: Practice shooting attacks.
rows.notes: 'Shageki kougeki' = shooting attacks; no glossary term.

rows.en: Sheryl: "It's a pain, but next I'll explain the basics of shooting attacks.\n         You've got ME explaining, so if you don't learn it, you'll be sorry."
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened line 2

rows.en: Practice melee attacks.
rows.notes: 'Kakutou kougeki' = melee attacks; no glossary term.

rows.en: Ranka: "Umm... here I'll explain the basics of melee attacks.\n        It's tough with so much to learn, but I'll do my best explaining too!"
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened line 2

rows.en: Practice Special Maneuvers 1.
rows.notes: 'Tokushu dousa' = Special Maneuvers; no glossary term.

rows.en: Sheryl: "Here I'll mostly explain the special maneuvers related to piloting.\n         If you're aiming to go pro, you'd better learn at least this much."
rows.notes: review: refit: dropped 'properly'

rows.en: Practice Special Maneuvers 2.
Ranka: "Here I'll mainly explain the SP-related special maneuvers.\n        They look a bit hard, but listen closely and learn them well, okay?"
rows.notes: review: refit: tightened line 2

rows.en: Practice container transport.
Sheryl: "All right, next I'll explain container transport.\n         I'm the one explaining it. Of course you'll pick it up right away."
Practice piloting in Real Flight Mode.

uncertain: row 565: source writes the band name in full-width capitals; glossary spelling 'Fire Bomber' used rather than all-caps.
row 574: objective with unusual phrasing ('rare fight' + 'scorch your ecstasy'), possibly a lyric reference; rendered 'Set your ecstasy ablaze in a one-of-a-kind fight!'.
row 575: kept Sheryl's '-chan' honorific for Ranka; Ranka's line uses the known 'everyone, hold me tight... to the ends of the galaxy' + 'Kira' shape.
row 576: objective voiced from a villain side; rendered with 'we' as the player's side.
row 595: epithet 'mikata-goroshi' rendered 'the Ally Killer'; 'ikka/oyabun' rendered 'family/boss' (yakuza flavour).
row 601: source break is a full-width yen + full-width n (typo, would print literally); written as the normal backslash-n break. Check warns 0 -> 1 for this row; deliberate.
row 617: unattributed quotes from the Macross F finale; speakers not named, trailing comma of the deliberately unfinished line kept.

rows 567/575/625-639: speaker-prefix format 'Name: "..."' kept; continuation line indented with ASCII spaces to align under the opening quote (source uses full-width spaces). Indent width may need adjusting at insertion.
missing_glossary: Sara Nome's title 'kaze no michibikite' (row 591): used as 'Guide of the Wind'
'tokushu dousa' tutorial term (rows 634-637): used as 'Special Maneuvers'
